AccessLevel.description: MCP server access level (readonly = safe tools only, standard = safe + normal, full_access = all tools)

GetStatus.description: Returns MCP server status (active connections, registered tools)

role.description: Resolved access role (e.g. readonly, standard, full_access)

last_seen_age_ms.description: Milliseconds elapsed since last request; absent for persistent legacy connections

GetMcpServerTools.description: Returns the list of MCP tools visible at the current access level, for UI display

SetAccessLevel.description: Set the global access-level ceiling live on the running MCP server. Persistence to HKLM is handled separately via NvIGOUtil SetMcpServerAccessLevel.

McpOverlayToolCallNotification.description: Broadcast when McpServer forwards an overlay tool call to Overlay UI

requestId.description: Correlation id for the tool call

SendMcpOverlayToolResponse.description: Overlay UI sends tool execution result back to McpServer

errorCode.description: Machine-readable error code when status is error

retriable.description: Whether the MCP client may retry the tool call

McpGameEventNotification.description: Overlay UI fires a game event notification to McpServer for delivery to subscribed MCP clients

processId.description: OS process ID of the game

fullscreen.description: Whether the game is in fullscreen mode

McpOverlayStateChangedNotification.description: Overlay UI fires a state change notification to McpServer for delivery to subscribed MCP clients as nvapp/state_changed

state.description: Updated state snapshot for the changed category

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the state change

object._comment: Fields reach MCP clients only if listed in kWireToolFields in McpAdapter.cpp. Adding a key here does not publish it. '_meta_internal' is server-side only and never sent.

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_get_status
tools.description: Returns high-level runtime state across all categories (active view, capture, recording, stats, audio, filters, notifications).

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_get_current_game_info
tools.description: Returns whether a game is currently running, with its name, process ID, and fullscreen state when available.

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_capture
tools.description: Control capture features: recording, instant replay, screenshots, and highlights.

enable.description: Required for toggle_* actions (true=enable, false=disable). Do not send for save_instant_replay or capture_screenshot.

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_configure_filters
tools.description: Enable or disable the RTX Dynamic Vibrance (DVC) filter.

enable.description: true to enable, false to disable

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_configure_stats
tools.description: Show or hide the performance statistics overlay.

enable.description: Show or hide the stats overlay

tools.name: nvapp_overlay_echo
tools.description: Echoes a message via the NVIDIA Overlay UI. Use for testing overlay MCP connectivity.

message.description: The message to echo back via overlay

emit_event.description: Which overlay notification(s) to emit after echo completes (testing aid)

object._comment: Fields reach MCP clients only if listed in kWireToolFields in McpAdapter.cpp. Adding a key here does not publish it. '_meta_internal' is server-side only and never sent.

tools.name: nvapp_echo
tools.description: Echoes the input message back. Use for testing NvApp SDK connectivity.

require_confirmation.description: Testing aid for MCP 2026-07-28 multi round-trip requests. When true, the server returns an input_required result and the call only completes after the client confirms. Ignored by clients using MCP 2025-11-25 or earlier.

simulate_progress.description: Testing aid for MCP progress notifications. When true and the request carries a progressToken, the echo runs as a short multi-step async operation emitting notifications/progress before completing. Ignored if no progressToken is provided.

tools.name: nvapp_get_gpu_info
tools.description: Returns information about installed NVIDIA GPU adapters including name, VRAM, vendor/device IDs.

tools.name: nvapp_client_get_applications
tools.description: List NVIDIA app-discovered games and applications with OPS details. Optional inputs filter results; omit all to return every app. Returned game names identify apps in game-scoped tools.

game.description: Optional exact game or application name previously returned by this tool. Omit to enumerate all discovered applications.

preset.description: Optional preset to validate. Requires game.

optimizationProfiles.description: Optimization state and available presets for AC and battery power profiles. currentState is a status, not a preset. Backend DC maps to battery.

currentState.description: Configured optimization state for this power profile.

availablePresets.description: Presets supported by this power profile.

unavailableReason.description: Why presets cannot be applied and how to proceed.

currentState.description: Configured optimization state for this power profile.

availablePresets.description: Presets supported by this power profile.

unavailableReason.description: Why presets cannot be applied and how to proceed.

tools.name: nvapp_client_launch_application
tools.description: Launch a game or application returned by nvapp_client_get_applications.

game.description: Exact game or application name returned by nvapp_client_get_applications.

limitations: The game name must exactly match a current application record returned by nvapp_client_get_applications.
Executable paths and arbitrary shell commands are not supported.

tools.name: nvapp_client_get_driver_status
tools.description: Get the installed driver, compatible driver recommendations, previous driver information.

recommendedDrivers.description: All compatible recommendation channels for this system: Game Ready and Studio on GeForce; NVIDIA Recommended, Leading Edge, and Conservative on workstation systems.

previouslyInstalledDriver.description: The single previously installed driver retained by the NVIDIA app web layer and available for rollback, or null when no previous driver is available.

tools.name: nvapp_client_get_driver_release_notes
tools.description: Get release highlights for the installed driver or a compatible recommended driver flavor.

driver.description: Driver whose release highlights should be returned. INSTALLED selects the currently installed driver; any flavor selects that exact current compatible recommendation.

tools.name: nvapp_client_set_game_optimization
tools.description: Apply a game optimization preset or restore defaults for a supported game. The AC power profile is used when powerSource is omitted.

game.description: Exact game or application name returned by nvapp_client_get_applications.

preset.description: Preset to apply: Performance (frame rate), Balanced (slider midpoint), Recommended (NVIDIA per-game recommendation), Quality (image quality), or Revert (restore defaults for the selected power profile).

powerSource.description: Optional power source whose OPS profile is changed. Defaults to AC when omitted. MCP Battery maps to backend DC. This value of 'Battery' for this setting is only applicable when battery boost is supported on the system.

tools.name: nvapp_client_get_laptop_features
tools.description: Get Battery Boost and Whisper Mode settings globally or for a game. This setting is applicable only for notebooks.

game.description: Game name from nvapp_client_get_applications. Use 'global' or 'base' for global settings; defaults to global.
Game name when scope is application.

useGlobal.description: Whether the application inherits the global setting. Returned only for application scope.
Whether the application inherits the global setting. Returned only for application scope.

tools.name: nvapp_client_set_laptop_feature
tools.description: Set Battery Boost or Whisper Mode globally or for a game. This setting is applicable only for notebooks.

game.description: Game name from nvapp_client_get_applications. Use 'global' or 'base' for global settings; defaults to global.

useGlobal.description: Whether the application should inherit the global setting. Valid only for application scope.
Whether the application should inherit the global setting. Valid only for application scope.
